evidence_basis: Author supplied printed metadata JSON; assistant did not access native files or SQLite contents. Totals are derived from reported groups.

decision.dataset_first: Immutable manifest/transactions, archived inventory and HGB policy, existing verify_data, explicit run ID
decision.study_next: Consistent SQLite snapshot coordinated with model, prediction, attempt and report artifacts; link to dataset run ID and manifest/archive hashes

limits: Lock file existence is not proof of an active writer
Study byte count includes database and artifacts; no logical or physical backup has been performed
Separate recovery units follow data/state responsibilities; their references must be preserved
